finviz_screener_strategies_query_check.name: finviz_screener_strategies_query_check
finviz_screener_strategies_query_check.value: "finviz_screener_strategies"."view" ~ '^[0-9]{3}$' and ("finviz_screener_strategies"."signal" is null or "finviz_screener_strategies"."signal" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,47}$') and "finviz_screener_strategies"."filters" ~ '^([a-z][a-z0-9_]*_[a-z0-9._-]+(,[a-z][a-z0-9_]*_[a-z0-9._-]+)*)?$' and char_length("finviz_screener_strategies"."filters") <= 4000

pre_market_ideas_manual_check.name: pre_market_ideas_manual_check
pre_market_ideas_manual_check.value: ("pre_market_ideas"."manual_stop" is null or "pre_market_ideas"."manual_stop" > 0) and ("pre_market_ideas"."manual_target" is null or "pre_market_ideas"."manual_target" > 0) and ("pre_market_ideas"."stop_mode" <> 'manual' or "pre_market_ideas"."manual_stop" > 0) and ("pre_market_ideas"."target_mode" <> 'manual' or "pre_market_ideas"."manual_target" > 0)

schwab_transaction_runs_code_check.name: schwab_transaction_runs_code_check
schwab_transaction_runs_code_check.value: ("schwab_transaction_runs"."status" = 'succeeded') = ("schwab_transaction_runs"."code" is null) and ("schwab_transaction_runs"."code" is null or "schwab_transaction_runs"."code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_:.-]{1,64}$')

schwab_transaction_sync_window_check.name: schwab_transaction_sync_window_check
schwab_transaction_sync_window_check.value: ("schwab_transaction_sync"."history_from" is null) = ("schwab_transaction_sync"."checked_through" is null) and ("schwab_transaction_sync"."checked_through" is null or "schwab_transaction_sync"."checked_through" >= "schwab_transaction_sync"."history_from")

schwab_transactions_instrument_check.name: schwab_transactions_instrument_check
schwab_transactions_instrument_check.value: ("schwab_transactions"."type" = 'TRADE') = ("schwab_transactions"."instrument_id" is not null and "schwab_transactions"."symbol" is not null and "schwab_transactions"."asset_type" is not null and "schwab_transactions"."quantity" is not null and "schwab_transactions"."fees" is not null)

trade_annotations_plan_check.name: trade_annotations_plan_check
trade_annotations_plan_check.value: ("trade_annotations"."plan_entry" is null or "trade_annotations"."plan_entry" > 0) and ("trade_annotations"."plan_stop" is null or "trade_annotations"."plan_stop" > 0) and ("trade_annotations"."plan_target" is null or "trade_annotations"."plan_target" > 0) and ("trade_annotations"."plan_quantity" is null or "trade_annotations"."plan_quantity" > 0)

trading_risk_settings_percent_check.name: trading_risk_settings_percent_check
trading_risk_settings_percent_check.value: "trading_risk_settings"."risk_per_trade_percent" > 0 and "trading_risk_settings"."risk_per_trade_percent" <= "trading_risk_settings"."open_risk_percent" and "trading_risk_settings"."open_risk_percent" <= 100 and ("trading_risk_settings"."daily_loss_percent" is null or ("trading_risk_settings"."daily_loss_percent" > 0 and "trading_risk_settings"."daily_loss_percent" <= 100))

trading_risk_settings_count_check.name: trading_risk_settings_count_check
trading_risk_settings_count_check.value: ("trading_risk_settings"."max_trades_per_session" is null or "trading_risk_settings"."max_trades_per_session" between 1 and 20) and ("trading_risk_settings"."max_consecutive_losses" is null or "trading_risk_settings"."max_consecutive_losses" between 1 and 20)

trading_risk_settings_books_check.name: trading_risk_settings_books_check
trading_risk_settings_books_check.value: ("trading_risk_settings"."swing_allocation_percent" is null) = ("trading_risk_settings"."day_risk_per_trade_percent" is null) and ("trading_risk_settings"."swing_allocation_percent" is null or ("trading_risk_settings"."swing_allocation_percent" >= 0 and "trading_risk_settings"."swing_allocation_percent" <= 100 and "trading_risk_settings"."day_risk_per_trade_percent" > 0 and "trading_risk_settings"."day_risk_per_trade_percent" <= 100 and ("trading_risk_settings"."daily_loss_percent" is null or "trading_risk_settings"."day_risk_per_trade_percent" <= "trading_risk_settings"."daily_loss_percent")))
